हाँ, ₹2,000 की exact cash donation ₹2,000 से ऊपर नहीं है, इसलिए 80G receipt valid रहेगी। ₹2,000 से अधिक cash donation पर system receipt में सही non-80G notice अपने-आप दिखाता है।

Give Setu receipt engine cash, cheque और UPI entries को process करता है और gapless 80G receipt जारी करता है। आपके organisation के specific tax case की पुष्टि team से करा सकते हैं: WhatsApp +91 92019 58271 या /contact-us.

q: Trust ke multiple projects hain, kya receipt numbering project-wise rakh sakte hain without compliance issue?
a:
Give Setu mein receipt numbering **organisation-wise financial-year sequence** ke roop mein hoti hai, jaise RCP/2026-27/000481. Branch-wise tagging aur reporting available hai, lekin project-wise separate receipt series rakhna aur uska compliance treatment current reference mein confirmed nahi hai. Agar projects same trust/PAN ke under hain, is detail ko team aapke setup ke hisaab se confirm karegi.

Aap WhatsApp par **+91 92019 58271** par project structure aur current receipt format bhej sakte hain, ya /contact-us se enquiry submit kar sakte hain. Kya aapke multiple projects ek hi registered trust/PAN ke under hain?

q: Ek donor company ne PAN ke jagah GSTIN diya hai, 80G aur 10BD ke liye chalega?
a: GSTIN ko PAN ke badle 80G receipt ya 10BD filing mein accept kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi, yeh organisation aur donor record ke specifics par depend karta hai; team se confirm karna hoga. Details ke liye WhatsApp **+91 92019 58271** par message karein ya /contact-us form bhar dein.

q: Filing se pehle system missing PAN ya duplicate donor ko flag karta hai kya?
a:
Haan. Growth aur Advanced ke Compliance Centre mein filing se pehle missing PAN, PAN format/checksum errors aur duplicates flag hote hain. Dashboard valid PAN coverage aur missing-address list bhi dikhata hai, taaki correction filing se pehle ho sake.

Donor CRM phone, PAN ya email ke basis par possible duplicate pairs suggest karta hai; merge karne par dono ki giving history preserve hoti hai. Missing PAN donors ko automated WhatsApp aur email sequence bhi bheja ja sakta hai, jiska valid reply checksum validation ke baad record mein update hota hai. Growth mein saal ka 1 filing batch included hai; Advanced mein unlimited batches aur priority review queue hai. Aapka organisation abhi Growth category mein hai ya Advanced volume par?
